create_get_zacharys_karate_club: create a GraphsTuple representing Zachary's karate club social graph with 34 nodes and bidirectional edges
create_get_ground_truth_assignments: create ground truth assignments array for the 34 karate club members split between two instructors
build_network_definition: build a GCN network definition using two GraphConvolution layers with ReLU activation on the karate club graph
run_optimize_club: run the optimization loop with Adam optimizer to train the GCN on karate club node assignments
run_main_cli: run the CLI entry point that calls optimize_club with 30 training steps via absl app
